payout_quote: Earn your cash bonus of up to $2,500 in three steps: Open a new eligible Business Advantage Fundamentals Banking or Business Advantage Relationship Banking account by November 30, 2026. Deposit New Money within 30 days of account opening. Cash Bonus: $400 for $5,000; $700 for $15,000; $1,000 for $50,000; $1,500 for $100,000; $2,500 for $200,000.
payout_value_note: Tiered cash bonus based on New Money deposited within 30 days of account opening and maintained through day 90. $400/$5K, $700/$15K, $1,000/$50K, $1,500/$100K, $2,500/$200K.
numeric_basis: payout from official promotions.bankofamerica.com terms (tiered $400-$2,500); time: online application 45-90 min active. Balance maintenance is passive (not counted as active time).
steps: Open a new eligible Business Advantage Fundamentals or Relationship Banking account online through the offer page (offer code auto-applies) by November 30, 2026.
Deposit New Money into the new account within 30 days of account opening.
Maintain the daily balance at or above your tier's minimum during the Maintenance Period (days 31-90 after account opening).
Receive the cash bonus after the Maintenance Period ends.
catches: Requires $5,000-$200,000 in New Money deposited within 30 days and maintained through day 90 - significant balance parking.
Must be a new customer (not an owner/signer on a BofA Business Advantage account in the last 12 months).
Bank of America employees are not eligible.
Offer code must be applied at account opening to qualify.
If daily balance drops below $5,000 during the Maintenance Period, no bonus is earned.
Bonus is taxable income; BofA may withhold tax.
biggest_catch: The $2,500 tier requires $200,000 in New Money parked for ~90 days; the entry $400 tier still requires $5,000 parked. This is a balance-parking play, not free money.
eligibility: New Bank of America business customers (not an owner/signer on a BofA Business Advantage account in the last 12 months). Business Advantage Fundamentals or Relationship Banking account.
timing: Open by November 30, 2026. Deposit New Money within 30 days of account opening. Maintain balance during Maintenance Period (days 31-90). Bonus paid after Maintenance Period ends.
notes: Public offer (code auto-applies online, not mailer-targeted). Distinct from R3782 (which covers a different BofA business offer variant). Recovery of R4715 which was rejected on incomplete evidence.
